verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's LLC docs explicitly mention an EIN as part of the formation deliverables ('An EIN, which is used to file taxes, open bank accounts, and build your staff'), indicating the platform facilitates EIN acquisition alongside company formation. However, there is no dedicated documentation on the EIN application process itself (e.g., as a standalone add-on, pricing, turnaround time, or IRS filing mechanics), and no independent/community corroboration of the EIN service specifically. Missing for 10: a dedicated EIN service page/pricing details, description of the process/turnaround, and independent verification that the EIN is actually obtained (vs. just mentioned as a byproduct).
